title.narrative: Building Capacity and Strengthening Monitoring and Evaluation Capability of India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd

description.narrative: "Strengthening IIFCL's organizational needs in the following areas: 1. Quality assurance to cover the task of implementation of ISO 9000 quality standards: The IIFCL plans to develop a quality management system to meet the needs and requirements of ISO 9000 certification 2. Human resource strategy and implementation: It is expected that the IIFCL will build appropriate capacity in a time-bound action plan over the next couple of years. In discussions with the IIFCL, the Bank has also stressed the need to have a market-oriented flexible HR policy that will allow the IIFCL to use a pool of external talent on a needs basis (for specific sectors, or special financing structures) while a core group of permanent professional staff would manage the IIFCL's operations. Such a structure would also support the Government's desire of keeping the IIFCL a lean organization while fulfilling its mandate of long-term debt financing to infrastructure projects. The IIFCL plans to bring onboard experts to help implement a market-oriented HR strategy to match with its evolving business needs. 3. Strengthening IIFCL's monitoring and evaluation capacity: improving accountability, responsiveness and efficiency and maximizing the use of scarce resources. This would include use of performance indicators, assessment of risks and evaluation of results of IIFCL's activities. The key development objective of this IDF Grant is to build the capacity of the India Infrastructure Company Finance Limited (IIFCL) to fulfill its mandate of long-term debt financing for infrastructure projects. The proposed IDF Grant supports the strengthening of IIFCL's organizational needs, a critical step to enhance its capacity to be able to effectively and efficiently implement its activities. It includes three components: (i) Strengthening IIFCL's monitoring and evaluation (M&E) capacity (ii) Raising IIFCL Service Quality to International Standards (iii) Human resource strategy and implementation"
